facebook.caption: POV: you took a wrong turn in Dương Đông and found a lake nobody at your resort mentioned. Duong Dong Lake is a local sports scene, not a postcard. Kayaking, paddleboarding, morning joggers lapping the edge. Real Phu Quoc energy, zero tourist markup. 4.1 stars from 64 reviews, and most of those reviewers probably live here. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch locals actually use this lake. Kayaks launching, sneakers hitting the path, zero resort branding in sight. Duong Dong Lake is the Phu Quoc most tourists drive straight past.
